findings.trigger_condition: equal hashable/unhashable pair, e.g. {1} and frozenset({1})
findings.impact: self-dependency through equal values not raised as cycle; duplicate equal nodes in layers
findings.suggested_validation: dependency_layers([({1}, frozenset({1}))]) should raise DependencyCycleError, returns [[frozenset],[set]]

findings.root_cause: DependencyCycleError.__init__ formats message via repr of every node
findings.impact: cycle path can raise unrelated exception instead of DependencyCycleError
findings.suggested_validation: node with raising __repr__ in [(x,x)] should still raise DependencyCycleError

findings.trigger_condition: real cycle containing a node whose __repr__ raises
findings.root_cause: DependencyCycleError.__init__ calls repr(n) for every node while building the message
findings.impact: cycle path can surface RuntimeError instead of DependencyCycleError, breaking the .nodes contract
findings.suggested_validation: BadRepr node in [(x,x)] should raise DependencyCycleError with nodes==(x,), not RuntimeError
